up: Retrieve IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against human Bifunctional epoxide hydrolase 2 (CHEMBL ID: CHEMBL2409). For each activity record, return the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, and PubMed ID or DOI, together with the assay description, target ChEMBL ID, and target preferred name.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, a.standard_value AS ic50_nM, ass.description AS assay_description, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2409' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '='
